ambient_events: The bass drops a whole step and the floor answers — a hundred people finding the same pulse at once.
A sheet of blue laser fans out over the crowd, freezing everyone mid-motion for a strobe-lit instant.
The DJ rides a filter up and up until the room is holding its breath, then lets it break.
Someone's drink catches the light — a cold blue star travelling through the dark toward the floor.
The haze machine breathes out and the beams overhead turn solid, sweeping like searchlights.
A cheer goes up near the booth for a drop only the front row saw coming.
The whole ceiling pulses once, hard, in time — white, then black, then white.
description: Voltage is a black box built around a beat. The dancefloor is sunk two steps into the middle of the room, lit from beneath through a lattice of blue-white cells that pulse with the music; above it, a rig of moving beams paints the haze in slow sweeps. The bar runs the length of the far wall in a single unbroken ribbon of backlit ice, the DJ booth raised on a plinth to one side like an altar. Off to the north, past a velvet rope and a doorman who has already decided about you, a stair climbs to somewhere quieter and much more expensive.
name: Main Floor
